template.name: Test Case Outline Document
template.description: Test case outline with unit test nodes and integration test edges for Xbowl user stories

metadata.storyName: Design Workflow in Visual Canvas with Component-Based Architecture

metadata.name: Canvas Layout Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test that the canvas layout component renders correctly with proper structure and navigation
metadata.userAction: User enters design mode and accesses canvas
metadata.expectedBehavior: Canvas layout renders with proper structure, navigation, and workspace validation
testScenarios: Normal scenario - Authenticated user accesses canvas
Error scenario - Unauthorized user redirected to login
Edge case - Workspace access issues show appropriate error

testData.input: User authentication data, workspace permissions
testData.expectedOutput: Properly structured canvas layout with navigation
testData.mockData: Mock user data, workspace data, permission data

metadata.name: Workflow Designer Page Loading Test
metadata.description: Test that the workflow designer page loads correctly with workspace data and user preferences
metadata.userAction: User accesses workflow designer page
metadata.expectedBehavior: Page loads with workspace data, user preferences, and existing workflow state
testScenarios: Normal scenario - Page loads with existing workflow data
Error scenario - Data fetching failures show loading states
Edge case - Empty workspace shows appropriate empty state

testData.input: Workspace data, user preferences, workflow state
testData.expectedOutput: Fully loaded workflow designer interface
testData.mockData: Mock workspace data, user preferences, workflow state

metadata.name: Seven Core Node Explorer Rendering Test
metadata.description: Test that the seven core node explorer renders correctly with organized folder structure and active state management
metadata.userAction: User explores available component types in left panel and selects components
metadata.expectedBehavior: Explorer displays 7 core component types organized in folders with active state highlighting and component selection
testScenarios: Normal scenario - All 7 component types displayed in organized folders with active state
Error scenario - Invalid component type data shows error state
Edge case - Empty component types show appropriate empty state
Active state scenario - Selected component highlighted with background color
Component switching scenario - Active state changes when different component selected

testData.input: Component type definitions, folder structure data, active component state
testData.expectedOutput: Properly organized component explorer with active state highlighting
testData.mockData: Mock component type data, folder structure, active state, selection state

metadata.name: Widget Selector Functionality Test
metadata.description: Test that the widget selector opens and allows user to select desired widgets for canvas

Error scenario - Invalid widget selection shows validation error
Edge case - No available widgets shows empty state

testData.input: Selected node type, widget categories, user selection
testData.expectedOutput: Widget added to canvas with proper positioning
testData.mockData: Mock widget data, category data, selection state

metadata.name: React Flow Canvas Component-Specific Rendering Test

State preservation scenario - Component canvas state preserved during switching

testData.expectedOutput: Component-specific canvas with focused node rendering
